Options
-------

  LANG=code           the language of the text (one the pack has)
  PAK=file            the game pack
  WINDOW              in a window on the Workbench (or PUBSCREEN=name) instead of a screen
  SCALE=1|2|3|auto    larger; ASPECT: in the shape of a 4:3 monitor
  MODE=id             the screen mode (default: the best for 640x400)
  AUDIO=ahi|none, AHIUNIT=n, RATE=Hz (default 44100), VOLUME=percent
  OPN=lite2           a finer FM sound for about 1.6 times the CPU
  STORAGE=dir         where the saves go
  QUIET               no messages in the shell
  VIEW                browse the pack's pictures instead of playing (VIEW="" in the shell)
